current_answer: Fifteen listed ambassador routes have issuer-linked ways to apply and no published passed deadline: Hedera, Cyfrin, Soneium, Aster, Elk, Nomis, Torium, Nexo, Oasis Sentinels, Fiber, Bybit Africa Campus, HeLa, Cronos, Zerion and Injective. Injective’s official page links a Zealy route and says INJ rewards depend on contribution impact, but it does not publish individual reward, workload or selection terms. Arc Architects is an ambassador program without a general application: participation earns points, while roles use separate selection; Arc says the points have no monetary value. BNB Chain’s old Martians form now returns 404, so it is not listed as a current route. Pendulum remains Discord enrollment, Wager Predict remains unconfirmed, Bitget’s campaign remains open through 30 Sep, MetaMask is not confirmed, Solana and SideShift are closed, and PIVX is referral-only.
